data.title: British Museum bans photos of Bayeux Tapestry as crowds linger
data.description: LONDON - The British Museum has banned visitors from taking pictures of the Bayeux Tapestry in order to keep the crowds flowing through an unprecedented London exhibition, a spokesperson confirmed Monday.

data.title: El Nino weather pattern enters record territory: scientist
data.description: NEW YORK - The strengthening El Nino weather pattern has tied for the most intense on record on a widely-used metric, a senior scientist told AFP Monday, even as its influence is already being felt from Central America to Indonesia.

data.title: Man shot by ICE agent in Texas detained with bullet inside him: lawyer
data.description: AUSTIN - A Venezuelan national shot and wounded by a US immigration agent in Texas was jailed with the bullet still inside his body, his lawyer said Monday.

data.title: South African ostriches plucked alive for luxury fashion: report
data.description: JOHANNESBURG - South African ostrich farms are using mechanical pluckers to remove feathers from living birds destined for major luxury fashion brands in techniques that are cruel and painful, animal welfare group World Animal Protection said on Monday.

data.title: US media outlets to sue Trump administration after White House ban
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - Three leading US news outlets announced Monday they will go to court after being banned from the White House, as President Donald Trump claimed that media critical of his administration is a "Cancer" threatening national security.

data.title: German auto workers stage mass protests in bid to save jobs
data.description: HANOVER (GERMANY) - German automotive workers held nationwide protests on Monday calling for government and management action to protect jobs and factories in an industry facing severe headwinds.

data.title: Supply issues, attacks on refineries driving diesel prices upward
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Prices at the pump for diesel and other fuels are hitting fresh highs in many countries as the wars and the Middle East and Ukraine have not only choked off crude supplies, but also damaged refineries, with the resulting capacity constraints increasingly being felt, according to analysis out of France.

data.title: COP31 host says AI's climate footprint to be a summit priority
data.description: NEW YORK - COP31 host Turkey said Monday that pursuing "climate-responsible AI" and pushing tech companies to power data centers with clean energy would be priorities when it stages next month's summit.

data.title: Renewables hit record in 2025, but world must move faster: report
data.description: NEW YORK - A new report has shown global renewable power capacity grew by record levels last year, with the findings hailed as a sign by the UN climate chief that the "brute power of market forces" is making the transition to clean energy irreversible.

data.title: Merz vows to keep ruling coalition together for 'democratic future' of Germany
data.description: BERLIN - Chancellor Friedrich Merz vowed Monday to keep his ruling coalition together for the sake of Germany's "democratic future" after crushing defeats in two regional elections fuelled speculation about his future.

data.title: Flights scrapped,1.6 million people urged to evacuate as Typhoon Dujuan nears Tokyo
data.description: TOKYO – Hundreds of flights were cancelled, and more than one million people were under evacuation advisories in Japan on Monday as Typhoon Dujuan approached Tokyo, potentially bringing record rainfall.

data.title: Putin's party secures record score in Russia election
data.description: MOSCOW - Vladimir Putin's United Russia party won a record supermajority in the Duma, authorities announced Monday after a tightly controlled three-day election without parties critical of the Kremlin or the war in Ukraine.

data.title: Schoolgirl Yu scorches to second gold as doping case rocks Asian Games
data.description: NAGOYA (JAPAN) - Schoolgirl swimmer Yu Zidi won her second gold of the Asian Games on Monday with the fastest time in the world this year, while a teenage badminton player became the first doping case.

data.title: Officials say man shot, wounded by ICE agent in Texas
data.description: AUSTIN — A Venezuelan national was shot and wounded by an immigration agent in the United States, Texas officials said on Sunday as they voiced outrage and demanded a thorough investigation.

data.title: Sisters of jailed Pakistan ex-PM Imran Khan arrested
data.description: ISLAMABAD — Former Pakistan prime minister Imran Khan's party said on Monday that his three sisters had been arrested.

data.title: China confirms Xi to visit US this week for Trump talks
data.description: BEIJING — China's leader Xi Jinping will visit the United States this week for talks with President Donald Trump, Beijing confirmed Monday, expressing hope they will strengthen "strategic stability" between the world's two largest economies.

data.title: Indonesia doing 'everything' but still struggling to curb fires
data.description: PONTIANAK, Indonesia - Indonesia is doing "everything" to fight huge forest fires but dozens of planes and thousands of personnel are still struggling to contain them, a senior official said on Monday.

data.title: Japan braces for heavy rain, strong winds as typhoon nears eastern coast
data.description: A large typhoon was moving towards eastern Japan's Pacific coast Monday, with the weather agency issuing a top-level warning for landslides in the northern part of the Izu island chain.

data.title: Report claims US has deported 25,000 to third countries under secretive deals
data.description: NAIROBI - The United States has deported more than 25,000 people under secretive agreements with 35 countries to take migrants with no ties to those nations, according to an investigation report published on Monday.

data.title: Macron welcomes Canada's Carney to French Atlantic territory
data.description: SAINT-PIERRE - French President Emmanuel Macron on Sunday welcomed Canada's Prime Minister Mark Carney to France's tiny North Atlantic territory of Saint Pierre and Miquelon, just off the Canadian coast.

data.title: Germany's Merz under pressure after bruising state election losses
data.description: BERLIN - German Chancellor Friedrich Merz starts the week more damaged than ever after his centre-right CDU party suffered two bruising regional election defeats at the hands of far-right and far-left parties.

data.title: Malaysia's 'elephant whisperer' fights to save Borneo's endangered giants
data.description: SUKAU, Malaysia - Deep in Malaysia's Borneo jungle, wild shouts fill the air as a Bornean elephant is darted and her angry herd rallies to protect her.

data.title: Thousands march in France against 'licence to kill' draft law
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Thousands of people marched in Paris and other French cities on Sunday against a proposed law on the legitimate use of force that critics say would be a "licence to kill" for police and gendarmes.

data.title: 'I live in fear': 1.5 million Pakistani children sexually exploited online
data.description: ISLAMABAD - Pakistani teenager Zara Shah was targeted by a stranger while playing a computer game, drawn into a conversation that would expose her to terrifying online sexual exploitation.

data.title: Top US, Chinese economic officials meet ahead of Trump-Xi summit
data.description: NEW YORK - US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng began talks Sunday, as they set the stage for possible agreements on trade, AI and other issues before a summit of the countries' top leaders.

data.title: US warns of rapid escalation in Mideast war
data.description: RIYADH (SAUDI ARABIA) - The United States warned that fighting between Saudi Arabia and Iran-backed Houthis could "escalate rapidly" after a missile attack targeted Riyadh for the first time since the Yemen conflict resumed.

data.title: Russians vote on last day of parliamentary elections
data.description: MOSCOW - Russians headed to the polls on Sunday for a third and final day of tightly controlled parliamentary elections set to strengthen the Kremlin's grip on power, as the Ukraine war grinds through its fifth year.

data.title: Hong Kong customs seizes record B533m marijuana shipped by sea from Thailand
data.description: HONG KONG - Customs has made the largest seizure of drugs shipped by sea in Hong Kong's history, discovering HK$125 million (533 million baht) worth of marijuana in a 40-foot container and arresting three people.
